title: Three Nights and One Short Cone
subtitle: 危险防范 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 危险防范（人与自然·灾害防范·危险与逃生）
meta: 主题语境：危险防范（人与自然·灾害防范·危险与逃生）　|　核心词汇：hole　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hole 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the officer ① filled the hole that no walker in the road would have described, and he said the filling was the whole of the night. The ② hole, meaning the gap itself and not the cone, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a hole, he said, is the only thing in a road that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hole in that road had the same short cone beside it, and the ④ hole at the far bend, meaning the crack they kept for the children to avoid and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hole, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the officer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hole was the whole of the matter, meaning the danger and not the gap. The ⑥ hole, meaning the danger and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hole, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a gap and a danger. He said the danger is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ hole had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short cone. The ⑧ hole of the whole thing, the officer wrote in December, was one road and three nights of describing; hole, he said, is either the crack at the far bend or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hole I remember is the gap described in the report, which closed in 1993 and is still described as the quietest in the road. A ⑩ hole, my mother said in 1995, is the only gap that improves by being described; every hole, she said, is a danger that has agreed to look like a gap. She said the danger was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 洞；坑（指路段里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 洞；坑（指那个坑洞本身，与锥筒相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the hole 填补坑洞
D. n. 洞；坑（指留给孩子们绕开的那一个）
E. n. 险情之事（抽象总称，指一处路段的坑洞之事）
F. n. 洞；坑（指报告里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 危险、隐患（指一件事里人人都绕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐患（抽象总称，指人人都绕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the hole that no walker in the road would have described
The hole, meaning the gap itself and not the cone
the hole at the far bend
the hole was the whole of the matter
the hole had become a line in a report
The hole of the whole thing
A hole, my mother said in 1995

answers.why: fill the hole 意为“填补坑洞”，1986 年那位巡路员把路段里没有一位行人肯描述的一个坑洞做了一遍。
hole 意为“洞；坑”，指那个坑洞本身而不是锥筒，它经过了三个夜而在簿子上没有被描述。
hole 意为“洞；坑”，指路段里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的锥筒。
hole 意为“洞；坑”，指最远那处弯道留给孩子们绕开的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hole 意为“危险、隐患”，指一件事里人人都绕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个隐患就是那件事的全部。
hole 意为“隐患”，指人人都绕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个坑洞，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hole 意为“洞；坑”，指报告里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1991 年这一个成了报告里的一行。
hole 意为“险情之事”，巡路员十二月写道，整件事的坑洞之事是一处路段和三个夜的描述。
hole 意为“洞；坑”，我记得的是报告里描述过的那一个，1993 年填平了，至今仍被说成路段里最安静的一个。
hole 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，坑洞是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的坑洞。
